g.text: What is a key?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: A key is a unique identifier for each item in the list.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: It is required to be passed especially when rendering the list using the .map().

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Keys help React to identify which items have changed, added or removed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Without keys React cannot track elements properly and throws a warning

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: that Each child in the list should have a key prop.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Rules for a key:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Keys must be unique among siblings

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - user.id

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Keys must be stable - they should not change in between renders.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - database uuid

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - uuid stored in the data

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - unique combination for each item

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Avoid using the array indexes as key

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Problem:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - breaks when items are reordered

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - react can reuse wrong DOM elements

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Allowed in specific cases:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - list is static

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - no reordering / addition / removal of elements

g.text: React Forms

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: React forms are controlling the input fields and managing the state, validating

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: data and handling the submission of forms.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: instead of using individual states for each field we use an object containing

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: key value pair for all the fields where key is referred by the name property

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: of the input field

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Best Practices for React Forms

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Use one state object to manage multiple field data

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - cleaner and scalable

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Use 'name' attribute as object keys

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - one change handler can be used to update all the fields

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Prevent Default on submit

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - it avoids page reload

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Validate before submitting

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - ensures data is secured and required fields have the data.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. Use controlled components

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - using input values coming in from React state

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: useCallback

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: React is all about rendering and re-rendering.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Memoization - it is an optimization technique which is used to speed up the program

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: by storing the result of expensive function calls and resulting the cached result

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: when the same inputs are received.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: How it works?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. when a function call is made, memoization checks whether the result for those

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: inputs is already saved

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. if found, returns the result from cached data

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. if not, computes the result and then returns the data also saving it to cache

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: useCallback is used to memoize the functions meaning the function is not created

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: on every render unless certain dependencies change.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. on every re-render in React, the functions are redefined and this becomes

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: inefficient if the function is passed as a prop to child component as it will

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: trigger unnecessary updates without any dependency on the function.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. useCallback will avoid unnecessary creation of function by memoizing them

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: it returns memoized version that changes when one of the dependency is changed

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: const memoizedFunction = useCallback(() => {

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: // logic here

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: }, [dependencies])

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Recreation prevention - useCallback memoizes the function so it does not get recreated

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Optimization - It can help avoid unnecessary renders of child component or unnecessary

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: re-evaluation of side effects that depend on the function

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Dependencies - ensure the dependencies are marked appropriately because if unnecessary

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: dependencies are included it can lead to missed updates.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: useMemo

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: useMemo is React hook used to memoize result of a computation so that the computation

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: is only re-run when any of the dependency is changed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: It is useful for expensive calculations or when we have to maintain stable values between renders

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: How useMemo works?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. runs a function only when the dependencies are changed

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. returns the memoized value if same inputs received

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. prevents unnecessary recalculations on every render

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
